title: Manner of Oxenford
html_source: Mulligans doubled-edged ‘compliment’ to Stephen in Telemachus ‘you have the true Oxford manner’ . Stephens inner Shakespearean rewording here implies he knew exactly the insult Buck Mulligan was giving him -your a homosexual. Notice how Buck Mulligan often insinuates that certain people are Gay.

anchor.prefix: Mulligan whispered with clown's awe. Did you see his eye? He looked upon you to lust after you. I fear thee, ancient mariner. O, Kinch, thou art in peril. Get thee a breechpad.
